name: Anna
review: Move to a new country is very stressful, looking for an apartment in London is challenging. But totally honestly thanks to the team of Uniqletts the renting process was very smooth for me and my fiancé. Thank you Rupa, Paola and Sam professional and well organised support with the rental contract!

name: D
review: Excellent service, excellent people. Always very responsive, considerate and helpful. Will miss having them as my agency!

name: Costa Podaru
review: It was a pleasure and so easy to deal with such a professional team .

name: Kirsty
review: We needed to find/move into a property in London in a very quick time frame and Uniqletts were fantastic. They made signing the agreement quick and painless and we were moved in within 2 weeks. Rupa and Paola provided a personal friendly service and were able to help when we had any queries. Would very happily use Uniqletts again.

name: Elise
review: Rupa in the team are always very helpful, quick to respond and fix problems quickly. They are very professional and the flat we rented from them was very clean when we moved in. The house had also been recently repainted. Professional move out and clean service as well. We would use them again if we needed them.

name: Mina
review:
It was a great experience with Uniqletts."
Rupa, Paola and Sam are very responsible and kind .
Looking forward to choose them as our agent again.

name: Jess
review: Both Luna and Rupa were quick to respond every-time we contacted them and were very helpful and friendly. Would definitely recommend them!

name: Steph
review:
Amazing time working with Rupa, Sam and Paola. Extremely respectful and friendly to deal with and always there when we needed them.
Would recommend to anyone!

name: May Leung
review: Shafiq and Rupa have taken care of our flat for many years. During this time they managed the flat very well, taking care of any leakages/pests and have been incredibly efficient and trustworthy. We would like to thank them dearly and would like to stay in touch.

name: Noor Dean Rajab
review:
I rented a small flat in High Street Kensington as I pursued my studies at Imperial College. The team at Uniqletts were prompt at solving any issues I had faced over the course of my stay. Even with my tight schedule the team was flexible and kind enough to help out.
Special thanks the Mr. Shafiq, Anna, Paola, Rupa, and Sam for their support and kindness. Highly recommend Uniqletts.

name: Rebecca
review: I have been in contact with Uniqletts only over a few queries, but they answered them all promptly and resolved issues straight away. All that was done with great politeness, it was a pleasure to work with them.

name: Marco Passone
review:
Ottimi professionisti
Precisi e puntuali e con Paola si parla anche in italiano.. ;)

name: Barry
review: I would like to thank Uniqletts for their help in finding me a new flat and making my move straight forward, despite having to run to a very tight schedule. They provided a fast and efficient service and I have no hesitation in recommending them.

name: Jordan
review: Luna and the team were extremely professional and helpful throughout the entire process. Operating to the highest level amidst a tight schedule really impressed me. I would definitely recommend this agency .

name: Elle
review: This is a small and friendly agency. Thanks to Rupa, Sam and Paola, they are extremely nice and prompt with high efficiency before signing agreement. After signing the agreement, we don\\'t have much issues, but most have been fixed although sometimes we have slow response. We understand it and would like to recommend.

name: Martine
review: Uniqletts is really a great letting experience. Rupa, Sam and Paola are very friendly and understanding. If there ever was an issue with the house, they would do what they could to assist. Being an international living in a foreign country, it has been very nice to have agents I could trust and have a good relationship with. I would strongly recommend this company.

name: Chris Gourlay
review: Rupa and Paola were professional, friendly and fair. Happy tenant :)

name: Christian
review: Rupa always delivers, working very hard around the clock. It's been trouble free having them as an agent.

name: Anita
review: I found Rupa and her team to be very helpful and friendly. Efficient with moving in and moving out. Thanks for all of your help.

name: JAMES
review: Very Helpful amongst the madness of a move.

name: Raouf Lotfy
review: Rupa was extremely helpful and professional. She was very quick to respond and made the move quite easy and smooth. I would highly recommend Uniqletts to anyone!

name: Az
review: From the day of my first ever interaction with Uniqletts I've been beyond impressed by the attentive personalised service and depth of knowledge. Rupa and Shafik have become my trusty property management gurus - they're simply brilliant and I can't imagine ever going to anybody else! I've already made recommendations to my neighbour and a dear colleague and I'm confident that they too will have no regrets in switching to Uniqletts.

name: Gabriel Risa
review: The whole process went smoothly with the property viewed on Monday, documentation provided on Wednesday. and keys and payment on Friday. Overall a very painless experience, which is unusual for the London property market. Would recommend.

name: Caroline
review: Rupa, Sam and Paola very professional and helpful at every step. They made everything very easy for us and nothing was too big a problem for them.

name: David and Raissa
review: Our experience with Uniqletts was top class. Rupa and Sam are great people and good professionals, always helpful and very friendly. Highly recommended.

name: Rowley Clifford
review: Very friendly, small agency. No pressure or sales jargon which was a nice change from other London agents I have dealt with. Would recommend!

name: Alex J
review:
If agents were more like Rupa from Uniqletts, the sector would have a great name. Warm, unsalesy and extremely professional, Rupa was probably the only person that I trusted in every way during my search.
I don't know how she does it but I really hope nothing changes as she will be the first person I call in future.

name: Noor
review: I rented a small flat in High Street Kensington as I pursued my studies at Imperial College. The team at Uniqletts were prompt at solving any issues I had faced over the course of my stay. Even with my tight schedule the team was flexible and kind enough to help out. Special thanks the Mr. Shafiq, Anna, Paola, Rupa, and Sam for their support and kindness. Highly recommend Uniqletts.

name: Joao
review: Thank you Rupa, Paola and Sam - it was a great experience having you as agents. Very diligent and professional people, communication was always easy and friendly. Very different from the treatment you normally get in London. Would definitely recommend you guys. Keep up the good work!

name: Pierre
review: I had the great pleasure of dealing with Rupa from Uniqletts based in Queensway - she has a fantastic 'can do attitude', works quickly and efficiently and offers an estate agency service second to none. I would not hesitate to recommend her or her company to anyone.

name: Peter
review: Rupa and Team worked very efficiently for us in securing our apartment and all arrangements that went with it, we were moved in quickly and easily, and have had great support beyond what we would have expected even after we had settled in.

name: Dulce
review:
Shafiq, is the best person we could came across when we arrived in London.
He helped us out through all renting details in the most honest and friendly possible way."
I would definitely recommend this agency. 5 stars

name: Laura
review: I have been highly impressed by the excellent service that Uniqletts has provided me with during my tenancy contract. Any problems that occurred in terms of property maintenance were always dealt with very quickly and professionally and the communication and customer service from the staff was excellent. I would definitely use Uniqletts again in future and would thoroughly recommend their services to others.
